description: The line plot titled "Performance w.r.t. Temperature" illustrates the relationship between temperature and accuracy, measured as Pass@8, for three different methods: On-policy RL, LUFY, and SFT. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," is a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)," is also a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The On-policy RL line, marked with yellow triangles, shows a fluctuating trend with peaks and troughs, starting at approximately 67.5 and ending near 75.0. The LUFY line, marked with red stars, generally trends upward, starting around 75.0 and ending near 80.0. The SFT line, marked with blue diamonds, exhibits a more variable pattern, starting near 70.0 and ending around 72.5. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions about the cause of the changes observed.
